articles.title: Quantum fears already limiting Bitcoin’s growth, Stacks founder says
articles.snippet: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast, Muneeb Ali warned that uncertainty over Bitcoin’s quantum security could deter institutional investors.

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
articles.snippet: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone's hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Tokenized Stock Battle Looms Over Robinhood’s Earnings Call
articles.snippet: One of crypto’s primary growth sectors for this upcoming cycle is under attack. Will Vlad Tenev speak up on today’s Robinhood earnings call?

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Fixes Critical Flaw That Redirected Funds to Attackers
articles.snippet: A confirmed exploit let rogue servers replace Electrum’s pending transactions, tricking users into redirecting Bitcoin to attacker addresses.
